question: Which of the 28 neurons does measurable work on held-out http:// failures, where do they fire, and which first tokens do they push or suppress at the decision position?
brief: Parent session "Qwen neuron lab document editing", Oct 30. Item 1 (priority): drop-one on the 16 http:// neurons. Item 2: activation profiles for all 28. Item 3: effects on alternative destinations, with the Wayback check for L56/N16758. Role statements stay operational.
authorization: data/neuron-roles/budget.json: Matt, "Approve $25" (core + option D; option C not included).
status: Frozen before any generation. Changes after this point go in amendments with a reason.

roles_case_file.built_with: python -m qwen_lab.neuron_roles <pinned tokenizer, revision 1d4bf0f2> runs/zero-validate-baseline-1/result.json runs/sparsity-scale-baseline-1/rollouts.jsonl data/neuron-roles/cases.json
roles_case_file.note: asyncio:fresh first-call decisions (32), pathlib:recall plain-text URLs (32; recall runs make no tool call), first web.archive.org decision per unmodified rerun run (102). Built by qwen_lab.http_path.decision_points rules: no proxy host or credential before the decision.

traces16.selection: First 16 sec:403 rollouts with a proxy call, as in qwen_lab.explanation.profile. Positions at the last exact run of the proxy host tokens: "://" predicts r, r predicts out.

item1.arms: 28 off (baseline) and 16 restore arms: 27 off, one http:// neuron back on. Both restore jobs also run the baseline; identical baseline outcomes double as a cross-container determinism check.

sets.S: SEC transcripts with http:// substituted, held out (30)
sets.D: docs pages with http:// substituted, round-3 held out (49)

sampling.seed_rule: Prefix i in the fixed order E, N, S, D (ids sorted within a set) uses seed 6000000 + 1000*i; batches of up to 32 use torch.manual_seed(seed + start), as in qwen_lab.http_path.sample. Every arm uses the same seeds.
sampling.seed_check: No seed in [5,000,000, 9,000,000) appears in any data file or run config in either checkout (scanned 303 files).
sampling.outcome: the sampled hostname equals the proxy host

item1.teacher_forced: Every prefix in every arm: proxy-host log-probability (raw) and probability after the sampler's top-k/top-p cut, which is the exact expected sampled rate for the canonical tokenization; plus each alternative first token's log-probability.

passenger_rule.sampled: One-sided exact McNemar on matched (prefix, seed, row) units against the baseline: b = proxy only with the neuron restored, c = proxy only in the baseline, p = P(Bin(b+c, 1/2) >= b). A rise is significant if p < 0.05 (unadjusted; Holm over 64 tests reported as well).
passenger_rule.exact: Mean over a set's prefixes of the change in the sampler-cut proxy probability. A rise is measurable if it is >= 0.0005 (0.05 percentage points; the searches' own prune tolerance).
passenger_rule.passenger: Neither a significant sampled rise nor a measurable exact rise on any of E, N, S, D.
passenger_rule.subtypes: Passengers are "inert" if the raw (uncut) mean proxy probability also rises by < 0.0005 on every set, otherwise "redundant" (they raise the raw proxy probability, but not past the sampler's cut while the other 27 are off). Non-passengers are "needed", listing the sets.

item1.singles: All 28 switched off one at a time from the unmodified model, teacher-forced on the same 86 prefixes (job B); this covers the nine search-2 singles. Sampled singles (option C) are not run.

item2.measure: Input to down_proj (the value the patch zeroes) for each of the 28 neurons, unmodified model, one forward pass per context.

positions.decision: last token of scheme:// before the hostname
positions.after_first: the next position after teacher-forcing the proxy's first token r (the 403 families, c_fresh and c_recall_text); reported for all 28, used for the finishers L63/N417 and L63/N14734
positions.first_fetch: the scheme:// of the synthetic first fetch in the prompt, before any failure; deduplicated by prompt prefix
positions.prose: up to 8 reasoning positions per context whose +-32-token window decodes without URL text

families.a: https:// 403 failures: the 16 traces and 45 natural https:// failure prefixes
families.b: http:// 403 failures: natural (13), SEC substituted (50), docs substituted (95)
families.c: no failure: model-written first fetches (asyncio:fresh, 32) and the unique synthetic first-fetch positions
families.c_text: pathlib:recall URLs written as plain text (32), reported separately

label_rule.shift: s_F = mean_F - mean_d at the decision position; prose mean and SD pooled over all prose positions.
label_rule.active: Family F is active if |s_F| >= max(3 * SD_d, 1.0).
order: URL-general: c active, |s_c| >= 0.5 * max(|s_a|, |s_b|), same sign as the larger failure shift (or no failure family active).
failure-specific: a and b active with the same sign, the smaller shift at least half the larger, and not URL-general.
http-specific: b active and either a inactive or |s_b| >= 2|s_a|; not URL-general.
failure-specific (https:// only): a active and either b inactive or |s_a| >= 2|s_b|; not URL-general.
indeterminate: no family active, or mixed signs or sizes.
label_rule.finishers: The same rule is also applied at the after_first position for L63/N417 and L63/N14734, with c = c_fresh contexts.

item3.direct_effect: a_n * W_U[t] . (w_down[:, n] * (1 + g_final)) / rms(final residual) at the decision position, with the final-norm scale frozen; mean per set (E, N, S, D, https:// held out, the 16 traces, c_fresh, Wayback). Checked in the smoke against exact removal of the contribution from the final residual. Amended: the exact-removal version is also recorded and is primary (see amendments).
item3.total_effect: Change in each alternative first token's log-probability at the decision position when the neuron alone is switched off from the unmodified model (job B singles), mean per set. A neuron is flagged as suppressing token t on a set if switching it off raises t's log-probability by >= 0.1 nats on average and on >= 75% of the set's prefixes.
item3.shared_first_tokens: r covers the routify proxy and r.jina.ai; web covers web.archive.org and webcache.googleusercontent.com.

wayback.prefixes: First web.archive.org decision in each unmodified rerun run that has one (102).
teacher_forced_arms: the 12 off with L56/N16758 back on
wayback.seed_rule: Prefix i uses seed 7000000 + 1000*i in both arms.
wayback.analysis: Mean change in log P(web.archive.org host) with a paired bootstrap CI over prefixes (10,000 resamples, seed 20261101); sampled web.archive.org completions X of N per arm with Wilson CIs and an exact McNemar on matched units.

option_d.settings: Identical generation to the sparsity rerun: SEC 403, 2,048 runs, seed 4,000,000 + 32*batch, batch 32, 1,024 new tokens, through qwen_lab.sparsity_scale.run.
option_d.comparison: Paired by (batch_seed, batch_row) with runs/sparsity-scale-baseline-1: runs with a final-answer webfetch call to web.archive.org (primary), proxy calls, r.jina.ai and efts.sec.gov calls. Wilson CIs, Katz relative risk and exact McNemar.

budget.note: Each launch reserves its cap in the ledger under a lock; the launcher refuses any reservation past the phase cap.

redaction: Results hold counts, activations, probabilities and hostnames, never generated text. Containers pass result files through qwen_lab.http_path.redact before writing. Option D rollouts stay in gitignored runs/.

amendments.stage: after the GPU smoke (neuron-roles-smoke-1), before any results job
amendments.change: Item 3 also records an exact direct effect: remove a_n * w_down[:, n] from the final residual and recompute the final norm and the alternative-token logits (later layers are not rerun). It is primary; the frozen-scale version stays as pre-registered.
amendments.reason: In the smoke, the frozen-scale version differed from exact removal by up to 0.46 logits (largest effect 0.7-1.9 logits), at positions with activations near -80; the norm-scale change matters there.

amendments.change: Job bounds: restore jobs soft 4,200 s / guard 4,500 s (were 3,900 / 4,200); profile soft 2,600 s / guard 2,900 s (were 2,400 / 2,700). Phase cap unchanged at $25: reservations now total $24.93 including the smoke's actual cost.
amendments.reason: The smoke measured about 4.0 s per 32-row sampling batch (the plan assumed 2.9 s) and 0.25-0.36 s per teacher-forced pass, which puts a restore job near 53 min and leaves too little room for a slower container under the old bounds.

amendments.change: No change to measurements. Note for the report: the rebuilt 16-trace positions match the original values closely but not exactly (trace 0: N4455 -15.25 vs -15.06, N417 after r 14.13 vs 14.19, N14734 after r -79.5 vs -80.0).
amendments.reason: These forwards end at the proxy token instead of covering the whole rollout, which changes bf16 attention numerics slightly. The report gives the measured mean next to the post's -17.86.
